_meta.description: Paginated drive list from GET /api/vehicles/{vehicleId}/drives. Each item is a DriveSummary (subset of FR-3.4 for list rendering). Ordered startTime DESC, id DESC. Includes startLocation/startAddress/endLocation/endAddress (MYR-145) so the SDK can render origin/destination labels without per-row drive-detail fetches; the second item demonstrates the nullable-on-the-wire convention (all four location keys omitted when the underlying Drive row is empty). Deliberately omits energyUsedKwh/fsdMiles/routePoints -- those are in DriveDetail and DriveRoute. The SDK pairs this REST fetch with the WebSocket drive_ended subscription for FR-9.1/FR-9.2.
